implementation.native: evalf_complex_decimal_metered shares caller accounting through original-source admission, refinement, exact endpoint agreement and publication; the existing unmetered API and error type remain intact.
implementation.python: An explicit native-bridge budget selects the metered lane with terminal typed failures. The no-budget Option/None contract and real-function selection remain unchanged.

implementation.admission: Bounded hook discovery reads retained storage; unknown opaque owners do not reach public getters in the real fallback. Float precision metadata must be a positive exact integer.
implementation.compatibility: Preserves concurrent held-source reconstruction, exact zero, Decimal-based predicates and very small/large components. General Float arithmetic/comparison retains existing binary64 limits.
implementation.lambert_solver: Corrects the pre-existing LambertW import from a module that does not export it to the defining elementary.exponential module; complete positive, negative and affine real solver roots now reach evalf and float.
implementation.ci: The complex-decimal suites and neighboring float cases are selected against the built production extension. The complete Lambert suite retains its existing later selection, avoiding a duplicate full run.
